item.description: The HTTP/2 hook implementation incorrectly extracts HTTP method from httpx calls, particularly when methods are passed as positional arguments rather than keyword arguments. It also fails to properly assign URL and method attributes to HTTP2Record objects, causing assertion failures in tests.
item.contract: Modify the hook implementation to correctly extract HTTP method and URL from httpx calls regardless of whether they're passed as positional or keyword arguments. The HTTP2Record object should properly set its url and method properties using the correct interface.
item.acceptance: test_h2, test_h2_request, test_h2_response, test_h2_client_redirect, test_h2_client_not_found, test_h2_client_get_empty_request_content, test_h2_client_many_requests, test_h2_client_many_requests_session, test_h2_server_request, test_h2_server_response

item.description: The HTTP/2 hook incorrectly assigns method attributes to record.request._method instead of using proper property setters, breaking the expected interface contract.
item.contract: Change the hook implementation to properly set the method property on HTTP2RecordRequest objects using the public property interface rather than direct attribute assignment to _method.
item.acceptance: test_h2, test_h2_request, test_h2_response, test_h2_client_redirect, test_h2_client_not_found, test_h2_client_get_empty_request_content, test_h2_client_many_requests, test_h2_client_many_requests_session, test_h2_server_request, test_h2_server_response

item.description: The HTTP/2 hook's exception handling logic doesn't correctly create HTTP2Record instances when exceptions occur during HTTP/2 requests, leading to incomplete test coverage.
item.contract: Improve the exception handling in the hook to ensure that HTTP2Record instances are properly created even when exceptions occur during HTTP/2 requests.

item.description: The HTTP/2 hook doesn't correctly parse the HTTP method from httpx calls where the method is passed as the first positional argument instead of a keyword argument.
item.contract: Update the method extraction logic to handle cases where the HTTP method is passed as the first positional argument in httpx calls.
item.acceptance: test_h2, test_h2_request, test_h2_response, test_h2_client_redirect, test_h2_client_not_found, test_h2_client_get_empty_request_content, test_h2_client_many_requests, test_h2_client_many_requests_session, test_h2_server_request, test_h2_server_response
